Ravi (CSM): Kicking off a quick sync for Aurora Therapeutics onboarding re: SLA/SLO reporting + credit visibility. Need a clear external line and renewal playbook signal.
Carmen (Ops): I ran a brief sim this morning. Two small latency breaches during parallel model loads + one 2m outage from a misscaled job. Numbers below.
Sam (Support): I'll draft a calm customer note and a simple worked example for the onboarding packet.
Jon (Renewals): Please include a renewal flag: if projected credits >12% in a 30-day window, renewals should get notified.
Elena (Finance): Finance preference: default cap 12% per 14 days for onboarding windows; enterprise customers may opt out via an addendum.
Carmen (Ops): Simulation summary:
```
Event 1: parallel import rate-limit -> p95 820ms for 9m -> latency credit 5%
Event 2: background job retry storm -> 2m outage -> uptime credit 8%
Event 3: routing fallback -> p95 bump to 600ms for 6m -> latency credit 3%
Stacked (no cap): 16%
With proposed cap (12%/14d): final credit = 12%
```
Ravi (CSM): Good. Sam, can the customer blurb say "we will assess the window and apply any eligible credits" (avoid past-tense) and offer a 15-min walkthrough?
Sam (Support): Draft v1: "During onboarding we detected transient latency and a brief outage during parallel imports. We will assess your onboarding window against the SLA and apply any eligible service credits. If youd like, schedule a 15-minute review with your CSM to walk through the calculation"
Elena (Finance): Use "we will apply" — ack. Also add a line about the onboarding cap and link to the calculator.
Ravi (CSM): Also include a short FAQ bullet: "Why do imports cause warm-cache latency?" with a 1-line mitigation: stagger imports or request a pre-warm.
Jon (Renewals): I'll add a script: when credits >12% -> offer executive review + optional short-term discount on renewal to offset perceived instability.
eng-alert-bot: infra snapshot attached (3330001225) :white_check_mark:
Carmen (Ops): Ops action: tag onboarding incidents in the credits calculator so cap applies automatically.
Sam (Support): Action items:
- Sam: publish external note + worked example + link to credits calc (due EOD)
- Carmen: enable onboarding tag in calc and rerun sims for Aurora (due tomorrow)
- Elena: confirm cap with FP&A and legal (48h)
- Jon: update renewal playbook to surface >12% credit exposure (72h)
Ravi (CSM): Thanks all. We'll keep messaging upbeat and transparent. If Aurora execs ask, I'll offer the 15-min walkthrough. Closing thread and will fold into the onboarding playbook."
